 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice A.V.Sesha Sai

Order:

entities.text: Shaik Kadhar Basha vs The State Of Ap
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1. This is an application, filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Cr.P.C),
by the petitioner, seeking to quash the proceedings in F.I.R.No.187 of 2019, dated 25.07.2019 of Buchireddypalem police station, SPSR Nellore District, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 272, 273, 328 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Heard Sri C.Subodh, learned counsel for petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent/State.
3.
Both the counsel agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judge of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 4. In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in FIR No.187 of 2019, dated 25.07.2019 of Buchireddypalem police station, SPSR Nellore District, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 272, 273, 328 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006,

entities.text: Buchireddypalem police station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
